title: NMOS differential pair with resistive loads
description: Design an open-loop NMOS differential pair (tail current source, resistive drain loads) whose differential-mode voltage gain at 1 kHz is at least 8 dB across the full sky130-style tt/ss/ff process corner, 1.62-1.98 V supply, and -40..125 C temperature matrix, while its common-mode-driven differential output stays at or below 0 dB across the same matrix -- i.e. differential gain must exceed common-mode response by a wide margin.

target_specs.corners: sky130-style tt/ss/ff process x 1.62-1.98V supply x -40..125C

reference.notes: Two netlists for the identical topology (differential-drive and common-mode-drive excitation), gated together by one eval_descriptor -- see diff_pair_diff.spice's header for why. Generic (non-PDK) NMOS model stands in for sky130 devices; see README.md's 'Known limitation' note.

source.citation: Differential pair is a standard first analog IC design course topic; framed here in the style of AnalogCoder's (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) easy-tier task set, not reproduced from that repo (unlicensed).
